The most plausible selectivity mechanism is that levetiracetam engages SV2A/voltage-gated channel machinery that is aberrantly expressed or dependency-linked in neural-lineage tumors, and that loss of TP53 combined with activated MAPK/PI3K or chromatin-remodeler mutations lowers the apoptotic threshold to this otherwise weak calcium-channel blocker. Because the transcriptional signature is dominated by generic stress/proliferation genes and the drug's known pharmacology is neuronal, SV2A/CACNA1B/SCN1A expression and neural-lineage identity are the strongest predictors, with TP53 loss and MAPK/chromatin mutations as secondary sensitizers.
